movement.instructions: Move right normally. If blocked_forward and wall_height_px is greater than ceiling_clearance_px, retreat left off the platform. If the previous movement was left and Mario is still grounded, continue left. Once falling, return right.

criteria.run_right: Move right through a clear path.
criteria.brake_left: Move left to escape a blocked passage.

start_jump.instructions: Should Mario start jumping? If grounded and jump_held is false, jump for an enemy within40 pixels, a wall within48 pixels, or a pit within48 pixels. Exception: if wall_height_px is greater than ceiling_clearance_px, do not jump into that wall. Do not jump when retreating left off a ledge. Null means the hazard is absent. No hazard means no jump.

ceiling_hop.instructions: Is an enemy within32 pixels? Null means absent.

sustain_jump.instructions: Is motion rising? True only while rising. False when falling or grounded.
